title: 12 Best Riga's Craft Beer & Bar Scene
description: Explore Riga's vibrant craft beer and bar scene. Discover the top 12 pubs, breweries, and unique bars, from traditional Latvian taverns to modern taprooms.

places.name: Labietis Alus Darbnīca
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'Mežs' (Forest) brew, a dark ale with spruce tips, or any of their seasonal sour beers.

places.name: Valmiermuižas Beer Embassy (alus vēstniecība)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sample their unpasteurized unfiltered 'Gaišais' (Light Lager) or their rich 'Tumšais' (Dark Lager). Pair with a selection of local cheeses and smoked meats.

places.name: Folkklubs Ala Pagrabs
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try any of the local unpasteurized lagers on tap, like Užavas Alus. Pair it with their famous garlic bread or pork ribs.

places.name: Zobens un Lemess
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the bartender for their latest sour beer tap or a strong Estonian IPA; they often have unique Nordic selections.

places.name: Miezis & Kompānija
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grab a flight of their current tap offerings or ask for a recommendation from their vast bottled selection.

places.name: Easy Wine & Beer (Aldaru iela)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Opt for one of their seasonal craft beer taps, which often feature unique Baltic brews, or ask for a recommendation from their extensive wine list.

places.name: Autentika
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask about their current local craft beer taps; they often feature interesting seasonal brews from smaller Latvian producers.

places.name: Piesta krodziņš
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy a large pint of 'Gaišais Alus' (light beer) from a local brewery like Tērvetes or Užavas, paired with their delicious fried bread with garlic sauce.

places.name: One Two Beer
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the bartender for their newest small-batch IPA or a recommended stout from a lesser-known Baltic brewery.

places.name: Taka
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grab a local craft lager or a seasonal ale, and enjoy it on their outdoor terrace if the weather permits.

places.name: Bierhaus Riga
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try a large stein of Paulaner Hefe-Weizen or ask for one of their Latvian lagers on tap to compare styles.

places.name: Krogs Aptieka
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Order a local Latvian draught beer like 'Aldaris Gaišais' or 'Cēsu' – it's incredibly cheap and refreshing.
